_importance_overlay_action.tooltip: Colour each block by its importance, using the measure the Importance tab ranks by (Vesely–Fussell when it is defined, since Birnbaum saturates in a series system). Red = highest leverage (≥ ⅔ of the largest value), Yellow ≥ ⅓, Green below; the value is printed under each block. This is a RANKING, not a health reading: red means 'fix this first'. Greyed out until the run has importance measures: switch on Run ▸ Analysis ▸ Importance measures and run again.
